article.title: N1CTF-oflo WriteUp
article.content:
<p>如题.</p>
<p>使用<code>IDA</code>打开题目文件后, 发现没有识别出<code>main</code>函数, 可以初步判断是由于花指令造成的.</p>
<p>在左侧的函数列表里发现了<code>mprotect</code>函数, 这个函数是用来更改内存读写权限的, 隐约感觉有<code>smc</code>(<code>Self-Modifying Code</code>)的存在.</p>
<p>先从<code>start</code>函数定位到<code>main</code>函数所在的区段, 发现了明显的花指令特征:</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/nLudGhFiqPc3Kbl.png" alt="image-20201026135433040" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/nLudGhFiqPc3Kbl.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/nLudGhFiqPc3Kbl.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/nLudGhFiqPc3Kbl.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image-20201026135433040" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>试图用<code>GDB</code>调试到此位置:</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/pJzdlhiKQ9ejmrn.png" alt="image-20201026135656530" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/pJzdlhiKQ9ejmrn.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/pJzdlhiKQ9ejmrn.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/pJzdlhiKQ9ejmrn.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image-20201026135656530" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>于是在<code>IDA</code>里将光标定位至<code>0x400BB1</code>的位置, 按下U键取消定义, 然后在<code>0x400BB2</code>的位置按下C键<code>Make Code</code>, 然后再用<code>IDAPython</code>给<code>0x400BB1</code>变成<code>nop</code></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-Python" data-lang="Python"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">PatchByte</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mh">0x400BB1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mh">0x90</span><span class="p">)</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/tSpYQhRyq5vgVOE.png" alt="image-20201026140032321" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/tSpYQhRyq5vgVOE.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/tSpYQhRyq5vgVOE.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/tSpYQhRyq5vgVOE.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image-20201026140032321" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>继续往下分析, <code>0x400BBC</code>处还有几个神必数据莫得头绪. 不过从<code>BB7</code>跳转到了<code>BBF</code>, 所以继续往下看, 然后&hellip; 它<code>retn</code>了.</p>
<p>继续用<code>gdb</code>断点到<code>0x400BB7</code>, 然后接着调试:</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/qVp6i3Af4I9OoED.png" alt="image-20201026140355769" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/qVp6i3Af4I9OoED.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/qVp6i3Af4I9OoED.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/qVp6i3Af4I9OoED.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image-20201026140355769" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>可以看到程序控制流从<code>0x400BD0</code>跳到了<code>0x400BBD</code>, 接着跳转到了<code>0x400BD1</code>. 由此可以推测出<code>0x400BBC</code>处也是一个花指令. 先在<code>0x400BBD</code>的位置变成汇编, 再用相同的办法把<code>BBC</code>给<code>nop</code>掉:</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/rw6abV9ofCGcqUL.png" alt="image-20201026142128162" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/rw6abV9ofCGcqUL.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/rw6abV9ofCGcqUL.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/rw6abV9ofCGcqUL.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image-20201026142128162" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>由此可以看出来, 从<code>0x400BB7</code>到<code>0x400BD0</code>的一大段代码实际上全是无效代码. 用<code>IDAPython</code>写个循环全部变成<code>nop</code>就完事了:</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/DSlg8c3Rnx1XBAk.png" alt="image-20201026142313218" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/DSlg8c3Rnx1XBAk.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/DSlg8c3Rnx1XBAk.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/DSlg8c3Rnx1XBAk.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image-20201026142313218" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>在<code>0x400CBA</code>处还有一个长得一模一样的东西, 同样处理之, <code>0x400D04</code>还有一坨, <code>nop</code>掉即可.</p>
<p>全部搞定之后把光标移到最上面的<code>main</code>处, 戳一下F5, 代码就反编译成功了:</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/y1P4qCtMxwAaTHf.png" alt="image-20201026142819634" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/y1P4qCtMxwAaTHf.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/y1P4qCtMxwAaTHf.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/y1P4qCtMxwAaTHf.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image-20201026142819634" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>第<code>20</code>行弄了个函数指针, <code>21</code>行用<code>mprotect</code>函数将某个<code>text</code>段的读写执行权限改成了<code>7</code>, 也就是<code>b111</code>, 即可读可写可执行. <code>22~23</code>行通过函数指针, 将该函数的前十个字节与<code>v4</code>的前五位异或, 然后第<code>24</code>行用刚刚修改过的函数对输入进行验证. 对部分变量重命名一下, 好康点.</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/eYopwS641ufyOij.png" alt="image-20201026143407379" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/eYopwS641ufyOij.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/eYopwS641ufyOij.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/eYopwS641ufyOij.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image-20201026143407379" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>可以发现是用了<code>flag</code>的前五位. 这个比赛的所有<code>flag</code>格式均为<code>n1ctf{xxx}</code>, 那么前五位必然是<code>n1ctf</code>.</p>
<p>定位到<code>evaluate</code>函数所在的位置, 用<code>IDAPython</code>把正确代码处理回来, 否则没法<code>F5</code>.</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/CpXsamqWn5LHzyR.png" alt="image-20201026144002533" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/CpXsamqWn5LHzyR.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/CpXsamqWn5LHzyR.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/CpXsamqWn5LHzyR.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image-20201026144002533" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>好极了, 代码恢复成功, F5试一下&hellip;失败了, 往下面一看, 还是有花指令.</p>
<p>想试着调试一下, 结果发现了</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/eYopwS641ufyOij.png" alt="image-20201026143407379" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/eYopwS641ufyOij.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/eYopwS641ufyOij.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/eYopwS641ufyOij.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image-20201026143407379" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>第<code>17</code>行那个函数, 里面调用了<code>ptrace</code>对程序的运行状态进行了监视. 而<code>gdb</code>也是通过<code>ptrace</code>进行调试的, 同一时间只能有一个调试器挂在程序上, 所以起到了反调试的作用. 不过往下看, <code>read</code>函数是在反调函数下面的, 所以可以先运行程序, 跑起来之后等待输入时用<code>gdb</code>再<code>attach</code>上去.</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/9RPCKSzqh8itkbY.png" alt="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/9RPCKSzqh8itkbY.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/9RPCKSzqh8itkbY.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/9RPCKSzqh8itkbY.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/9RPCKSzqh8itkbY.png?size=large 2x" data-title="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/9RPCKSzqh8itkbY.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>接下来定位到<code>0x400ABC</code>, 然后跟踪一下函数流程, 并把花指令都给处理掉. 有如下几个地方:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-Python" data-lang="Python"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mh">0x400AC4</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mh">0x400AC9</span><span class="p">):</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">PatchByte</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mh">0x90</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mh">0x400B0E</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mh">0x400B28</span><span class="p">):</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">PatchByte</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mh">0x90</span><span class="p">)</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>搞完了之后再<code>F5</code>一下, <code>evaluate</code>函数的真容就浮现出来了. 因为<code>smc</code>和花指令的影响, 之前<code>main</code>函数中给<code>evaluate</code>传的参数乱七八糟, 重新<code>F5</code>一下<code>main</code>函数, 找到这几行:</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/tCdFBJEX1gyvA9q.png" alt="image-20201026145602058" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/tCdFBJEX1gyvA9q.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/tCdFBJEX1gyvA9q.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/tCdFBJEX1gyvA9q.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image-20201026145602058" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>然后再看重命名之后的<code>evaluate</code>函数:</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/hN7m1LtlKy3O5vs.png" alt="image-20201026150058722" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/hN7m1LtlKy3O5vs.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/hN7m1LtlKy3O5vs.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/hN7m1LtlKy3O5vs.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image-20201026150058722" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>你可以右键参数, 然后选择<code>set lvar type</code>, 改成指针之后就能显示出来数组形式的表达式了.</p>
<p>第<code>39</code>行处理的地址是<code>&amp;v20+1-32</code>, 看一下上面的变量声明, 这个地方就是<code>v5</code>, 那么这个循环就是遍历了<code>v5~v18</code>.</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/5xzQaCKyLBG671j.png" alt="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/5xzQaCKyLBG671j.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/5xzQaCKyLBG671j.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/5xzQaCKyLBG671j.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/5xzQaCKyLBG671j.png?size=large 2x" data-title="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/5xzQaCKyLBG671j.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>还有个难题就是<code>space</code>里面存的到底是个什么东西了.</p>
<p>答案其实很简单, 我们点进那个反调试函数里面瞅一眼, 发现他运行了一下<code>/usr/bin/cat /proc/version</code>, 动态调试到<code>evaluate</code>里面, 输出一下栈里面的东西,</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/8iyECSWMnocX4Qb.png" alt="image-20201026152439543" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/8iyECSWMnocX4Qb.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/8iyECSWMnocX4Qb.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/8iyECSWMnocX4Qb.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image-20201026152439543" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>发现<code>space</code>存的实际上就是<code>/usr/bin/cat /proc/version</code>指令的输出, 即你的<code>linux</code>版本信息, 然后取前<code>13</code>位. 因为是<code>linux</code>程序, 所以不管在什么系统上, 前<code>13</code>位必然是<code>Linux Version </code>, 那就保证唯一性了.</p>
<p>接下来就是快乐的拿<code>flag</code>时间了.</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/JUIeNtiKOBwGvVC.png" alt="image-20201026152313624" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/JUIeNtiKOBwGvVC.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/JUIeNtiKOBwGvVC.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/10/26/JUIeNtiKOBwGvVC.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image-20201026152313624" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>脚本:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-Python" data-lang="Python"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="ch">#!/bin/python3</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"># from __future__ import print_function</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">magic</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">53</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">45</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">17</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">26</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">73</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">125</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">17</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">20</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">43</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">59</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">62</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">61</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">60</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">95</span><span class="p">]</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">space</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">&#39;Linux Version &#39;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">head</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">&#39;n1ctf&#39;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="nb">print</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">head</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">&#39;&#39;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">magic</span><span class="p">)):</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">chr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">magic</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">^</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">ord</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">space</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)),</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">&#39;&#39;</span><span class="p">)</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p><code>flag: n1ctf{Fam3_Is_NULL}</code></p><hr />

article.title: MssCTF 2020 赛后总结
article.content:
<p>如题</p>
<h2 id="运维与反作弊" class="heading-element"><span>运维与反作弊</span>
  <a href="#%e8%bf%90%e7%bb%b4%e4%b8%8e%e5%8f%8d%e4%bd%9c%e5%bc%8a" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p>在讨论平台的反作弊措施时有人提出了能否给不同选手分发不同题目文件的想法, 思索了一下觉得可行, 我便答应下来, 然后投入到静态题目文件自动分发插件的工作当中. 由于时间紧急就没能好好研究CTFd的文件上传与储存机制, 最开始的想法是创建一种新的挑战类型, 然后慢慢改; 后来写好之后发现数据库冲突了, 测试了好久依旧无法实现. 经<a href="https://blog.frankli.site/"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">Frank</a>的提示, 发现其实只要创建一种新的<code>flag</code>类型即可. 时间紧急就采用了最简单的写法, 在<code>api/v1/challenges.py</code>里直接判断<code>flag</code>类型然后返回对应的文件, 简单粗暴. 这样写出来的插件由于更改了平台原有的文件, 所以没法即插即用, 等有时间了好好研究一下如何在不更改原有<code>api</code>的情况下实现自动分发.</p>
<p>初赛太辛苦<code>BlackW@tch</code>了. 初赛Web题目采用了静态<code>docker</code>部署的方式, 所有选手共用一个环境. 赛前去看他部署的时候发现<code>apache</code>的日志输出直接映射到了<code>stdout</code>, 这样搞的没办法查看<code>log</code>了, 但是想着题目应该不会出啥大问题, 折腾了一会儿没折腾好就放弃了. 第二天就直接上线.</p>
<p>然后<code>web</code>题成功出问题了. 有一名选手拿到<code>flag</code>之后挂了个脚本持续删掉<code>flag</code>, 重启<code>docker</code>之后继续删, 活生生的把<code>CTF</code>变成了出题人和选手之间的<code>AD</code>. <code>bw</code>只想着赶快修好环境, 也忘记先导出日志抓人, 日志又被重定向到了<code>stdout</code>, 重启一下<code>docker</code>啥都没了, 最后想起来的时候人也没抓着, 比赛也快结束了.</p>
<p>初赛过程中自动分发插件倒工作良好, 没出什么幺蛾子.</p>
<p>复赛的账号分发任务交给我来做了, 采用自动注册脚本没费什么力气, 然后发送邮件拜托<a href="https://luoq1an.github.io/"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">洛千</a>用工具人做法全部发送到了选手的邮箱. 自动分发插件依旧沿用初赛的插件. <a href="https://blog.frankli.site/"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">Frank</a>收集了所有<code>web</code>和<code>pwn</code>题目之后采用<code>CTFd-Whale</code>插件把题目弄成了动态的, 选手启动自己专属的<code>docker</code>环境做题, <code>flag</code>也各不相同, 防止作弊的同时也有效避免了初赛选手删<code>flag</code>的问题. PPC评测由于<code>Windows</code>下换行符<code>CRLF</code>的问题导致测试题目部分选手写的代码没有通过, 不过没什么大碍. 整个复赛过程中平台运行情况挺稳定的, 整个复赛过程中动态题目总共创建了487次<code>docker</code>环境, 其中用于测试题目创建了51次, 选手解题创建了436次, 其中陈培琛启动了35次题目环境, 杜厚德启动了32次, 陈鸿嘉启动了29次, 在<code>&quot;浪费服务器性能排行榜&quot;</code>上夺得前三.</p>
<h2 id="逆向出题" class="heading-element"><span>逆向出题</span>
  <a href="#%e9%80%86%e5%90%91%e5%87%ba%e9%a2%98" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p>初赛逆向题目放出了三道, 有两道题目是我出的, 考点分别是指令虚拟化和全排列, 难度中等, 没爆0. 复赛题目放出了四道, 上午Java逆向和花指令, Java逆向是一个六元一次方程组求解, 两解; flower直接爆0了. 下午本来准备上happy出的一道vm, 但是上午看了看解题情况, 吓得不敢放了, 于是临时出了一个签到题, F5就能看见flag 的那种. 加上一道换表base64解密, 下午成功没有爆0. 有一说一题目质量出的有点低了&hellip; 没把握好选手的整体水平, 最后导致题目难度极不合理.</p>
<h2 id="总结" class="heading-element"><span>总结</span>
  <a href="#%e6%80%bb%e7%bb%93" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p>这大概是我参与命题的第四场比赛, 我参与运维的第二场比赛, 总体感觉挺良好的, <del>就是有点浪费肝</del>.</p>
<p>经验大概就是要好好把握选手的水平, 以后出题争取能把难度梯度设置的更合理. 运维方面可能就是要提前准备好, 预留足够多的时间, 把平台整好. 本次比赛期间我同时在维护新生赛<code>MoeCTF</code>的平台, 初赛前一周还在搭建MSC微软俱乐部的招新网站, 以及维护了一个福利题平台, 加上<code>MssCTF</code>反作弊插件的编写, 网信实验班的作业记录平台, QQ机器人, 还有战队考核等其他乱七八糟的事情, 这仨星期通宵了不知道多少次, 感觉生命值快烧完了都. 现在看了看时间表, 除了满满当当的课程之外好像没别的什么大任务了. <del>一定要好好调整作息, 免得英年早逝</del></p>
<p>PS: 初赛复赛总共蹭了五顿饭和一堆零食, 真好吃.jpg</p><hr />

article.title: POST
article.content:
<p>如题</p>
<h2 id="post是什么" class="heading-element"><span>POST是什么?</span>
  <a href="#post%e6%98%af%e4%bb%80%e4%b9%88" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p><code>POST</code>是一种<code>HTTP</code>请求方法, 通过网址中的参数来向服务器请求相应的网络资源.</p>
<p>更详细的<code>HTTP</code>请求方法介绍, 请见: <a href="https://developer.mozilla.org/zh-CN/docs/Web/HTTP/Methods"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">MDN文档</a></p>
<h2 id="如何post" class="heading-element"><span>如何POST?</span>
  <a href="#%e5%a6%82%e4%bd%95post" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p><code>POST</code>本质上和<code>GET</code>都属于给网站提供数据的请求方法. 只不过<code>GET</code>请求可以通过在网址后面直接构造的方法来使用, 十分的简单便捷.</p>
<p>而<code>POST</code>不同, <code>POST</code>是一种有报文的请求方式, 正常用户是无法显式看见<code>POST</code>请求的详细信息的.</p>
<p><code>POST</code>的方法有很多种, 我们只挑两种来讲.</p>
<h3 id="使用postman工具" class="heading-element"><span>使用<code>Postman</code>工具</span>
  <a href="#%e4%bd%bf%e7%94%a8postman%e5%b7%a5%e5%85%b7" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p>打开<code>Postman</code>, 界面大致如下:</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/08/07/LOtkXhljgHNqTKd.png" alt="Screenshot_20200807_122034.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/08/07/LOtkXhljgHNqTKd.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/08/07/LOtkXhljgHNqTKd.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/08/07/LOtkXhljgHNqTKd.png?size=large 2x" data-title="Screenshot_20200807_122034.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>如上设置好你的数据, 就可以非常方便的向服务器发送请求了.</p>
<h3 id="使用python的requests库" class="heading-element"><span>使用<code>Python</code>的<code>Requests</code>库</span>
  <a href="#%e4%bd%bf%e7%94%a8python%e7%9a%84requests%e5%ba%93" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p>使用<code>Python</code>的<code>requests</code>库是最灵活也是<code>CTF</code>中最常用的方法.</p>
<h4 id="安装requests库" class="heading-element"><span>安装<code>requests</code>库</span>
  <a href="#%e5%ae%89%e8%a3%85requests%e5%ba%93" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h4><p>确保你的电脑上有<code>Python3</code>;</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">$ python3 -m pip install requests -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple</span></span></code></pre></div><p><strong>请注意! 不要将<code>requests</code>错误的写为<code>request</code>, <code>request</code>库近期被检出投毒: <a href="https://bbs.pediy.com/thread-261274.htm"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">链接</a></strong></p>
<p>如果你使用<code>Linux</code>, 也可以在对应发行版的软件仓库里找到<code>requests</code>库的安装包. 例如<code>Arch Linux</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">$ sudo pacman -Syyu python-requests</span></span></code></pre></div><p>即可安装<code>requests</code>库.</p>
<p>尽量使用发行版的包管理器, 这样包管理器更新时会一并检查这些包并自动升级. 如果使用<code>pip</code>, 可能还需要隔一段时间手动更新以修复一些<code>bug</code>, 获得新的功能.</p>
<h4 id="使用requests" class="heading-element"><span>使用<code>requests</code></span>
  <a href="#%e4%bd%bf%e7%94%a8requests" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h4><p>使用如下脚本即可简单的对一个网站进行请求:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-Python" data-lang="Python"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="nn">requests</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">payload</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&#34;key&#34;</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&#34;value&#34;</span><span class="p">}</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">url</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&#34;https://www.example.com&#34;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">response</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">requests</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">post</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">url</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">data</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">payload</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="c1"># 发送请求</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">response</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="c1"># 输出响应主体</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">response</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">headers</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="c1"># 输出HTTP响应头</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p><code>requests</code>库的用法十分丰富, 还可以使用<code>session</code>来维持一个会话, 请熟练掌握.</p>
<p>关于更高级的用法本文不再介绍, 请阅读<a href="https://requests.readthedocs.io/zh_CN/latest/"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">requests官方文档</a></p><hr />

article.content:
<h2 id="数组索引-倒过来还是索引" class="heading-element"><span>数组索引, 倒过来还是索引</span>
  <a href="#%e6%95%b0%e7%bb%84%e7%b4%a2%e5%bc%95-%e5%80%92%e8%bf%87%e6%9d%a5%e8%bf%98%e6%98%af%e7%b4%a2%e5%bc%95" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p>由于数组索引被解释成<code>指针+偏移</code>, 所以我们用<code>偏移+指针</code>也未尝不可.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-C++" data-lang="C++"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="cp">#include</span> <span class="cpf">&lt;iostream&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="cp"></span><span class="k">using</span> <span class="k">namespace</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kt">int</span> <span class="nf">main</span> <span class="p">()</span> <span class="p">{</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">a</span><span class="p">[]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">6</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">7</span><span class="p">};</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">cout</span> <span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span> <span class="s">&#34;a[4]: &#34;</span> <span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span> <span class="n">a</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span> <span class="n">endl</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">cout</span> <span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span> <span class="s">&#34;4[a]: &#34;</span> <span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span> <span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">a</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span> <span class="n">endl</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span></span></span></code></pre></div><h2 id="lambda-的无限套娃" class="heading-element"><span><code>lambda</code> 的无限套娃</span>
  <a href="#lambda-%e7%9a%84%e6%97%a0%e9%99%90%e5%a5%97%e5%a8%83" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-C++" data-lang="C++"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kt">int</span> <span class="nf">main</span><span class="p">(){[](){[](){[](){[](){[](){</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">cout</span><span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span><span class="s">&#34;Hello World&#34;</span><span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span><span class="n">endl</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}();}();}();}();}();}</span></span></span></code></pre></div><blockquote>
<p>转自<a href="https://www.zhihu.com/question/37135445/answer/71144368"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">C++新标准中有哪些浪到没朋友的新写法？ - 王维一的回答 - 知乎</a></p></blockquote>
<h2 id="像python一样迭代" class="heading-element"><span>像<code>Python</code>一样迭代</span>
  <a href="#%e5%83%8fpython%e4%b8%80%e6%a0%b7%e8%bf%ad%e4%bb%a3" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-C++" data-lang="C++"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// When you are using C++ 98:
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span><span class="n">circle</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">p</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="k">new</span> <span class="n">circle</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">42</span><span class="p">);</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">vector</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">shape</span><span class="o">*&gt;</span> <span class="n">v</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">load_shapes</span><span class="p">();</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">for</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">vector</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">shape</span><span class="o">*&gt;::</span><span class="n">iterator</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">v</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">begin</span><span class="p">();</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="n">v</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">end</span><span class="p">();</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="o">++</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">&amp;&amp;</span> <span class="o">**</span><span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="n">cout</span> <span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span>  <span class="o">**</span><span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span><span class="s">&#34;is a match</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&#34;</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">for</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">vector</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">shape</span><span class="o">*&gt;::</span><span class="n">iterator</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">v</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">begin</span><span class="p">();</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="n">v</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">end</span><span class="p">();</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="o">++</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="k">delete</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">delete</span> <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// When you are using the new C++ 17
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span><span class="k">auto</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">make_shared</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">circle</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">42</span><span class="p">);</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">auto</span> <span class="n">v</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">load_shapes</span><span class="p">();</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">for</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="k">auto</span> <span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="nl">s</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">v</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">s</span> <span class="o">&amp;&amp;</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">s</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="n">cout</span> <span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">s</span> <span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span> <span class="s">&#34;is a match</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&#34;</span><span class="p">;</span></span></span></code></pre></div><blockquote>
<p>转自<a href="https://youtu.be/hEx5DNLWGgA"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">YouTube</a></p></blockquote>
<p>除了标准支持的<code>for</code>自动迭代器之外, 还有<code>std::for_each(container.begin(), container.end(), predicate_function)</code>与<code>Qt</code>的<code>for_each(item, container)</code>可用. 不过有了新标准之后这种写法更容易理解, 并且没有对库的依赖性.</p>
<h2 id="强大到没朋友的auto" class="heading-element"><span>强大到没朋友的<code>auto</code></span>
  <a href="#%e5%bc%ba%e5%a4%a7%e5%88%b0%e6%b2%a1%e6%9c%8b%e5%8f%8b%e7%9a%84auto" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p>据说2038年的C++标准就可以支持这么写了:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-C++" data-lang="C++"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">auto</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="k">auto</span><span class="p">](</span><span class="k">auto</span> <span class="k">auto</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">auto</span> <span class="p">{</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="k">auto</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">auto</span> <span class="k">auto</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="k">auto</span><span class="p">};</span> <span class="k">auto</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="k">auto</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="k">auto</span><span class="o">++</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="k">auto</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="k">auto</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="k">auto</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="k">auto</span> <span class="k">auto</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>(这个代码就是开个玩笑)</p>
<p>看上一节中的应用, <code>auto</code>几乎万能.</p>
<h2 id="像for一样在if和while里使用变量初始化" class="heading-element"><span>像<code>for</code>一样在<code>if</code>和<code>while</code>里使用变量初始化</span>
  <a href="#%e5%83%8ffor%e4%b8%80%e6%a0%b7%e5%9c%a8if%e5%92%8cwhile%e9%87%8c%e4%bd%bf%e7%94%a8%e5%8f%98%e9%87%8f%e5%88%9d%e5%a7%8b%e5%8c%96" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-C++" data-lang="C++"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">false</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="nb">true</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">cout</span> <span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span> <span class="s">&#34;Hello World~!&#34;</span> <span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">endl</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span> <span class="c1">// 可以输出
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="k">auto</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">func</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">parameters</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="n">judge</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">))</span> <span class="p">{</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="c1">// do something...
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span><span class="p">}</span> <span class="c1">// 根据judge()函数的判断决定要不要执行
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><hr />

article.title: C++ 虚函数
Linux 5.7.2 swapfile 无法挂载的解决方案
article.content:
<p>如题</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-text" data-lang="text"><span class="line"><span class="cl">[FAILED] Failed to activate swap /swapfile.
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">[DEPEND] Dependency failed for Swap.</span></span></code></pre></div><p>开机时报错如上, 开机之后交换文件无法正确被挂载.</p>
<p>在Arch Linux论坛上找到了解决方案如下:</p>
<p><a href="https://bbs.archlinux.org/viewtopic.php?id=256503"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">SOLVED: Swap not working with Kernel 5.7.2</a></p>
<p>这个问题仅出现在<code>ext4</code>文件系统下的 <code>Linux 5.7.2</code> 上, 使用<code>fallocate</code> 创建的swap交换文件.</p>
<p><a href="https://wiki.archlinux.org/index.php/swap"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">Arch Linux Wiki</a>的解释如下:</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> dynamic space allocation such as using <code>fallocate</code> is not supported, as it causes problems with some file systems such as <a href="https://wiki.archlinux.org/index.php/F2FS"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">F2FS</a>[<a href="https://github.com/karelzak/util-linux/issues/633"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">1]</a> and will likely fail to activate at boot time with error &ldquo;<em>swapon: swapfile has holes</em>&rdquo; as of kernel 5.7. Hence, contiguous allocation, such as <code>dd</code>, is the only reliable way to allocate a swap file.[<a href="https://manpages.courier-mta.org/htmlman8/swapon.8.html#swapon-8_sect3"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">2]</a></p></blockquote>
<p><strong>因此删掉原有的<code>swapfile</code>, 用<code>dd</code>重新分配即可.</strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo dd <span class="k">if</span><span class="o">=</span>/dev/zero <span class="nv">of</span><span class="o">=</span>/swapfile <span class="nv">bs</span><span class="o">=</span>1M <span class="nv">count</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="m">4096</span> <span class="nv">status</span><span class="o">=</span>progress
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo chmod <span class="m">600</span> /swapfile 
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo mkswap /swapfile 
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo swapon /swapfile</span></span></code></pre></div><hr />

article.title: Mini L CTF WriteUp By Int3rn3t_Expl0rer Team
article.content:
<p>wp</p>
<h2 id="mini-l-ctf-wp-by-arttnba3" class="heading-element"><span>Mini L CTF WP by arttnba3</span>
  <a href="#mini-l-ctf-wp-by-arttnba3" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><h2 id="hello" class="heading-element"><span>hello</span>
  <a href="#hello" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><blockquote>
<p>证明了我真的是菜鸡的一道<code>pwn</code>题, 搞了半天才明白XD</p></blockquote>
<p>做题环境<code>Manjaro-KDE</code></p>
<p>首先使用<code>checksec</code>指令查看保护, 可以发现保护基本都是关的, 只有<code>Partial RELRO</code>, 那么基本上是可以为所欲为了wwww</p>
<p><code>win</code>环境下拖进<code>IDA</code>进行分析</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/f4qnCg65NPxT2D9.png" alt="image.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/f4qnCg65NPxT2D9.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/f4qnCg65NPxT2D9.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/f4qnCg65NPxT2D9.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>可以发现在<code>vul函数</code>存在明显的栈溢出</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/67tk1FiacXVR8ou.png" alt="image.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/67tk1FiacXVR8ou.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/67tk1FiacXVR8ou.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/67tk1FiacXVR8ou.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p><code>main</code>函数中调用了<code>vul</code></p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/nKAZp7wUtfV3g6P.png" alt="image.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/nKAZp7wUtfV3g6P.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/nKAZp7wUtfV3g6P.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/nKAZp7wUtfV3g6P.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>那么程序漏洞很明显了:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>使用<code>fgets</code>读入最大为72个字节的字符串, 但是只分配给了48字节的空间, 存在栈溢出</strong></li>
</ul>
<p>又有一个可疑的<code>bd</code>函数, 那么第一时间想到**<code>ret2text</code>**——构造<code>payload</code>跳转到<code>bd</code></p>
<p>但是很明显, <code>bd</code>函数基本是是空的(悲)</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/59MVFNoviEYp4rn.png" alt="image.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/59MVFNoviEYp4rn.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/59MVFNoviEYp4rn.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/05/11/59MVFNoviEYp4rn.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<blockquote>
<p>然后我就在这里卡了半天, 证明我真的菜XD</p></blockquote>
<p>那么我们该如何利用这个<code>bd</code>呢？</p>
<p>可以看到在<code>bd</code>中存在操作<code>jmp rsp</code>, 那么其实我们可以利用这个指令<strong>跳转回栈上, 执行我们放在栈上的<code>shellcode</code></strong></p>
<p><strong>也就是说这其实是一道<code>ret2shellcode</code>的题</strong></p>
<h3 id="ret2text执行过程" class="heading-element"><span><code>ret2text</code>执行过程:</span>
  <a href="#ret2text%e6%89%a7%e8%a1%8c%e8%bf%87%e7%a8%8b" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><ul>
<li><strong><code>rsp</code>永远指向栈顶</strong></li>
<li><strong>当我们用常规的<code>ret2text</code>构造48字节字符串<code>+8</code>字节<code>rbp+8</code>字节<code>bd</code>函数地址 (覆盖掉原返回地址) 的<code>payload</code>时, <code>rsp</code>指向的其实是<code>bd</code>函数地址的位置</strong></li>
<li>**<code>ret</code>指令进入<code>bd</code>后弹出<code>bd</code>地址, <code>rsp</code>指向栈内储存的<code>rbp</code>的值 (预期内) **</li>
<li>**<code>bd</code>函数将<code>rbp</code>再<code>push</code>入栈中, 此时<code>rsp</code>再加8, 指向被新压入的<code>rbp</code> (预期内) **</li>
<li><strong><code>bd</code>函数执行<code>rsp</code>上的指令</strong>
那么我们就可以在<code>rsp</code>预期内指向的地址上覆盖上我们的<code>shellcode</code>使其被执行</li>
</ul>
<p>接下来就是<code>ret2shellcode</code>的:</p>
<h3 id="ret2shellcode修正过程" class="heading-element"><span><code>ret2shellcode</code>修正过程:</span>
  <a href="#ret2shellcode%e4%bf%ae%e6%ad%a3%e8%bf%87%e7%a8%8b" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><ul>
<li><strong>在<code>rsp</code>最终指向的地址放上我们待执行的<code>shellcode</code></strong></li>
<li><strong>由于长度不够, 我们可以把<code>getshell</code>的<code>shellcode</code>放在读入的字符串的最开始的地方, 再通过汇编指令进行跳转</strong></li>
<li><strong>在<code>rsp</code>所指向的位置覆盖上<code>shellcode</code>, 改变<code>rsp</code>的值使其指向<code>getshell</code>的<code>shellcode</code>并再次进行跳转, 完成<code>getshell</code></strong></li>
</ul>
<p>那么<code>payload</code>就很容易构造出来了:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-python" data-lang="python"><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">context</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">arch</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">&#39;amd64&#39;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">sc1</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">asm</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">shellcraft</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sh</span><span class="p">())</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">sc2</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">asm</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">&#39;sub rsp,64&#39;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">//</span><span class="mi">48</span><span class="n">字节的字符串</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="n">字节的rsp</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="n">字节的rbp</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">跳回开头</span>

</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">r</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">getPrime</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">510</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">e</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">r</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">h</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="n">m</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">%</span><span class="n">q</span>

</h2><p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/05/16/73PonCRQBGHvrAd.png" alt="zuotiqingkuang" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/05/16/73PonCRQBGHvrAd.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/05/16/73PonCRQBGHvrAd.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/05/16/73PonCRQBGHvrAd.png?size=large 2x" data-title="zuotiqingkuang" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>

<p>虽然只拿了第三, 没有<code>pwn</code>手也没有<code>Web</code>手的情况下也挺不错了hhh~</p>
<p>作为一个<code>Re</code>手自我感觉良好, 虽然安卓题就写了一道emmm</p>

  </a>
</h2><p>还是要继续学<code>Re</code>啊~ 同时作为一个二进制组员, <code>pwn</code>多多少少也要会&hellip;</p>
<p>毕竟<code>CTF</code>中<code>pwn</code>的比重太大了, 全盘放弃实在是伤&hellip;</p><hr />

<h2 id="另觅方法" class="heading-element"><span>另觅方法</span>

    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><h3 id="降级nodejs" class="heading-element"><span>降级Node.js?</span>
  <a href="#%e9%99%8d%e7%ba%a7nodejs" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">$ sudo pacman -U /var/cache/pacman/pkg/nodejs-13.13.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst</span></span></code></pre></div><p>用<code>pacman</code>的缓存降到了<code>13.13</code>版本, 这个方法工作了大概一个星期.</p>
<p>紧接着, <code>Node.js</code>的依赖库更新了&hellip;</p>
<p>于是 全 部 木 大</p>
<p>如果我想继续使用降级<code>Node.js</code>, 那我就必须把依赖库都降级, 同时还要降级其它的所有依赖的与被依赖的软件包, 直到官方兼容<code>Node 14.2</code>.</p>
<p>可是, 我这是<code>Arch Linux</code>啊, 降级? 大规模降级? 恐怕等官方修复了之后我再更新, 就滚挂了吧.</p>
<h3 id="虚拟机" class="heading-element"><span>虚拟机?</span>
  <a href="#%e8%99%9a%e6%8b%9f%e6%9c%ba" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p>尝试在Linux里面开Linux虚拟机竟然只是为了更新博客? 我感觉我脑子还没坏emm</p>
<h3 id="docker-docker" class="heading-element"><span>docker? docker!</span>
  <a href="#docker-docker" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p>那不如用<code>docker</code>吧.</p>
<p>安装好<code>docker</code>之后获取官方的<code>docker</code>镜像:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">$ sudo docker pull node:13.14.0-stretch</span></span></code></pre></div><p>用以下命令启动<code>docker</code>环境, 并挂载博客目录, 将<code>hexo</code>的服务器端口<code>4000</code>映射到本机的<code>4000</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">$ sudo docker run -it -p 4000:4000 -v &lt;Blog Location&gt;:/Blog node:13.14.0-stretch /bin/bash</span></span></code></pre></div><p>装好依赖, 配置好<code>git</code>的<code>SSH Key</code>, 然后使用<code>sudo docker ps -l</code>查询容器<code>pid</code>, 接着:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">$ sudo docker commit &lt;pid&gt; node:13.14.0-stretch</span></span></code></pre></div><p>保存配置好的环境.</p>
<p>编写一个简单的<code>.desktop</code>文件:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-json" data-lang="json"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">[</span><span class="err">Desktop</span> <span class="err">Entry</span><span class="p">]</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="err">Comment=</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="err">Exec=konsole</span> <span class="err">-e</span> <span class="err">&#39;sudo</span> <span class="err">docker</span> <span class="err">run</span> <span class="err">-it</span> <span class="err">-p</span> <span class="mi">4000</span><span class="err">:</span><span class="mi">4000</span> <span class="err">-v</span> <span class="err">/home/reverier/文档/Blog:/Blog</span> <span class="err">node:</span><span class="mf">13.14</span><span class="err">.</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="err">-stretch</span> <span class="err">/bin/bash&#39;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="err">GenericName=Docker</span> <span class="err">Blog</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="err">Icon=</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="err">Name=Blog</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="err">NoDisplay=</span><span class="kc">false</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="err">Path</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="err">$e</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="err">=</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="err">StartupNotify=</span><span class="kc">true</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="err">Terminal=</span><span class="mi">0</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="err">TerminalOptions=</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="err">Type=Application</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="err">X-KDE-SubstituteUID=</span><span class="kc">false</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="err">X-KDE-Username=</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>扔到<code>~/.local/share/applications</code>目录下面.</p>
<p>写博客还和以前一样, 写好之后点一下这个桌面文件, 输入<code>root</code>密码, 然后和以前一样更新博客就可以了.</p>
<h2 id="结尾" class="heading-element"><span>结尾</span>
  <a href="#%e7%bb%93%e5%b0%be" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p>学了一点简单的<code>docker</code>用法, 感觉还不错呢~</p><hr />

<h2 id="源代码" class="heading-element"><span>源代码</span>

    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p>出题人编写的源代码如下:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-C++" data-lang="C++"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="cp">#include</span> <span class="cpf">&lt;cstdlib&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="cp">#include</span> <span class="cpf">&lt;cstring&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="cp">#include</span> <span class="cpf">&lt;iostream&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="cp"></span><span class="k">using</span> <span class="k">namespace</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">const</span> <span class="kt">char</span> <span class="n">base</span><span class="p">[]</span> <span class="o">=</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="s">&#34;ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz01234{}789+/=&#34;</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">static</span> <span class="kt">char</span> <span class="nf">find_pos</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">char</span> <span class="n">ch</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="kt">char</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">ptr</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">char</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n">strrchr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">base</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ch</span><span class="p">);</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ptr</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">base</span><span class="p">);</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kt">char</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="nf">RxEncode</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span> <span class="kt">char</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">data</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">data_len</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">ret_len</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">data_len</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">equal_count</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="kt">char</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">ret</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="kt">char</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">f</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">tmp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">temp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">prepare</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">data</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">data_len</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="sc">&#39;=&#39;</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">equal_count</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="p">}</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">data</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">data_len</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="sc">&#39;=&#39;</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">equal_count</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="p">}</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">data</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">data_len</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="sc">&#39;=&#39;</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>  <span class="c1">// seems impossible
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>    <span class="n">equal_count</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="p">}</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="k">switch</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">equal_count</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="k">case</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="o">:</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">      <span class="n">ret_len</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">;</span>  <span class="c1">// 3 + 1 [1 for NULL]
