</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">v4</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="c1">// eax
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">v5</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="c1">// eax
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="n">_BOOL4</span> <span class="n">v6</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="c1">// ebx
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="kt">char</span> <span class="n">v8</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="c1">// [rsp+1Fh] [rbp-41h]
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="kt">char</span> <span class="n">v9</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="c1">// [rsp+20h] [rbp-40h]
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="kt">unsigned</span> <span class="kr">__int64</span> <span class="n">v10</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="c1">// [rsp+48h] [rbp-18h]
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="n">v10</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">__readfsqword</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mh">0x28u</span><span class="p">);</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">allocator</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="o">&gt;::</span><span class="n">allocator</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">v8</span><span class="p">);</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">__cxx11</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">basic_string</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">char_traits</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">allocator</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="o">&gt;&gt;::</span><span class="n">basic_string</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">v9</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">unk_3010</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">v8</span><span class="p">);</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">allocator</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="o">&gt;::~</span><span class="n">allocator</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">v8</span><span class="p">);</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="n">v2</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">o0o0o</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">a1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">a2</span><span class="p">);</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="n">v3</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">o0o0o</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">a1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">v2</span><span class="p">);</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="n">v4</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">o0o0o</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">a1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">a2</span><span class="p">);</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="n">v5</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">o0o0o</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">a2</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">v4</span><span class="p">);</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="n">v6</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">o0o0o</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">v5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">v3</span><span class="p">);</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">__cxx11</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">basic_string</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">char_traits</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">allocator</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="o">&gt;&gt;::~</span><span class="n">basic_string</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">v9</span><span class="p">);</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span> <span class="kt">int</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n">v6</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>其中又涉及到了<code>o0o0o()</code>函数, 这个函数原型十分简单, 就只有一句话: <code>return (a2 &amp; a1) == 0;</code></p>
<p>如果选手对数字电路有些许了解的话, 应该很轻松的可以辨认出, 这个函数是与非门(NAND门). 结合hint, 我们可以大致画出<code>Oo0O()</code>函数的结构:</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/04/21/58PUZ6cA1I7e4Mg.png" alt="NAND2XOR.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/04/21/58PUZ6cA1I7e4Mg.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/04/21/58PUZ6cA1I7e4Mg.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/04/21/58PUZ6cA1I7e4Mg.png?size=large 2x" data-title="NAND2XOR.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>这个结构走一遍, 实际上就是异或门(xor).</p>
<p>异或大家就很熟悉了. 稍微改一下IDA反编译出来的函数, 我们可以得到一堆Base64字符串.</p>
<p>其实没有学过模电问题也不大, 我们使用gdb, 在<code>o0o0OO()</code>函数前面下个断点, 就像这样:</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/04/21/X84IQpNOfhweqHc.png" alt="shc.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/04/21/X84IQpNOfhweqHc.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/04/21/X84IQpNOfhweqHc.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/04/21/X84IQpNOfhweqHc.png?size=large 2x" data-title="shc.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>然后你就可以看见寄存器指向的运算结果了, 继续跟踪, 我们可以把所有经过运算的字符串全部抓出来, 得到了一堆Base64.</p>
<p>这个时候你把Base64全部拿出去解码, 只能得到和程序运行之后的输出一样的一堆歌词, 并没有flag. 我们观察这些歌词的结尾大部分都是逗号, 然后结合hint的提示, 相同字符经过Base64编码后的结果是相同的, 但是你所抓出来的这一大串base64, 他们的结尾甚至都不相同. <code>,</code>经过编码后是<code>LA==</code>, 但是这些base64结尾不全都是这个. 这个时候你需要对Base64的解码过程有一定的理解, Base64解码过程中会舍弃<code>=</code>所对应的<code>padding</code>位, 这也是Base64隐写的原理.</p>
<p>因此我们把那一堆Base64用隐写提取脚本提取一下就可以了.</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/04/21/o6aZfG7wUd4Fvtx.png" alt="image.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/04/21/o6aZfG7wUd4Fvtx.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/04/21/o6aZfG7wUd4Fvtx.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/04/21/o6aZfG7wUd4Fvtx.png?size=large 2x" data-title="image.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>ICTFE中关于Base64隐写提取的函数如下:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-python" data-lang="python"><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">def</span> <span class="nf">base64_stego</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lines</span><span class="p">):</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">alphabet</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">&#39;ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/&#39;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">flag</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">&#39;&#39;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">temp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">digit</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">lines</span><span class="p">:</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="s1">&#39;=&#39;</span><span class="p">:</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">            <span class="k">continue</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="s1">&#39;=&#39;</span><span class="p">:</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">            <span class="n">digit</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">2</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">            <span class="n">temp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">temp</span> <span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">alphabet</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">find</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">&amp;</span> <span class="mh">0x3</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">            <span class="n">digit</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">4</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">            <span class="n">temp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">temp</span> <span class="o">&lt;&lt;</span> <span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">alphabet</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">find</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">&amp;</span> <span class="mh">0xf</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">digit</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">:</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">            <span class="n">digit</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">            <span class="n">flag</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="nb">chr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">temp</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">            <span class="n">temp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">digit</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">:</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">            <span class="n">digit</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">2</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">            <span class="n">flag</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="nb">chr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">temp</span> <span class="o">&gt;&gt;</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">            <span class="n">temp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">temp</span> <span class="o">&amp;</span> <span class="mh">0x3</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">flag</span></span></span></code></pre></div><hr />

article.title: wine-wechat 窗口阴影置顶解决方案
article.content:
<h2 id="前言" class="heading-element"><span>前言</span>
  <a href="#%e5%89%8d%e8%a8%80" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p>archlinuxcn中有打包好的wine-wechat应用, 但是该应用启动后有边框阴影特效, 此时如果有另一个应用覆盖在微信的窗口之前, 阴影就会被置顶, 从而造成一些视觉阻碍.</p>
<p>像下面这样:</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/mYfeQ8w3puBs5Wy.png" alt="Screenshot_20200214_145311.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/mYfeQ8w3puBs5Wy.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/mYfeQ8w3puBs5Wy.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/mYfeQ8w3puBs5Wy.png?size=large 2x" data-title="Screenshot_20200214_145311.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>非强迫症还好, 强迫症简直不能忍受. 即使不是强迫症, 这个阴影边框竟然还有调整大小的控件, 对日常使用造成了一定的阻碍. 本文介绍如何关闭这个阴影. 从理论上来说, 所有的出现问题的wine应用都可以应用此办法来解决.</p>
<h2 id="解决过程" class="heading-element"><span>解决过程</span>
  <a href="#%e8%a7%a3%e5%86%b3%e8%bf%87%e7%a8%8b" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><h3 id="xwininfo和wmctrl的使用" class="heading-element"><span>xwininfo和wmctrl的使用</span>
  <a href="#xwininfo%e5%92%8cwmctrl%e7%9a%84%e4%bd%bf%e7%94%a8" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p><code>xwininfo</code>是一个窗口查看工具. 我们可以在打开微信的情况下在终端输入<code>xwininfo</code>然后回车, <code>xwininfo</code>会让你用鼠标选取窗口, 然后输出这个窗口的详细信息.</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/cTFpRZSfzBoymb8.png" alt="Screenshot_20200214_145939.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/cTFpRZSfzBoymb8.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/cTFpRZSfzBoymb8.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/cTFpRZSfzBoymb8.png?size=large 2x" data-title="Screenshot_20200214_145939.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>选中阴影后我们可以查看窗口的<code>window id</code>, 在这里是<code>0xae00014</code>:</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/tOlIMNgXpK4scE2.png" alt="Screenshot_20200214_150004.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/tOlIMNgXpK4scE2.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/tOlIMNgXpK4scE2.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/tOlIMNgXpK4scE2.png?size=large 2x" data-title="Screenshot_20200214_150004.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>然后我们运行<code>wmctrl -l -G -p -x</code>来查看当前所有活动的窗口:</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/5uYAympMkr1TzdR.png" alt="Screenshot_20200214_150030.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/5uYAympMkr1TzdR.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/5uYAympMkr1TzdR.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2020/02/14/5uYAympMkr1TzdR.png?size=large 2x" data-title="Screenshot_20200214_150030.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p>通过多次实验, 我发现微信窗口后四位所对应的不同窗口层次是固定的. 主窗口是<code>0xXXXX000a</code>, 那么阴影所对应的窗口就是<code>0xXXXX0014</code>.</p>
<h3 id="通过xdotool来隐藏阴影窗口" class="heading-element"><span>通过xdotool来隐藏阴影窗口</span>
  <a href="#%e9%80%9a%e8%bf%87xdotool%e6%9d%a5%e9%9a%90%e8%97%8f%e9%98%b4%e5%bd%b1%e7%aa%97%e5%8f%a3" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p><code>xdotool</code>是一个很方便实用的工具. 我们可以通过它来隐藏某个窗口, 只需要提供<code>window id</code>就可以了. 使用方法如下:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">xdotool windowunmap &lt;window-id&gt;</span></span></code></pre></div><p>于是我们只要找到<code>wechat.exe</code>的<code>&lt;window-id</code>然后用<code>xdotool windowunmap 0xXXXX0014</code>就可以达成我们的目标了.</p>
<h3 id="编写python脚本并集成到系统里" class="heading-element"><span>编写Python脚本并集成到系统里</span>
  <a href="#%e7%bc%96%e5%86%99python%e8%84%9a%e6%9c%ac%e5%b9%b6%e9%9b%86%e6%88%90%e5%88%b0%e7%b3%bb%e7%bb%9f%e9%87%8c" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p>有了上面介绍的三个工具, 我们就可以通过写一个简单的小脚本来随着微信的启动而启动, 每五秒检测一次, 然后隐藏wechat的窗口阴影, 检测到wechat退出就自动退出.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-python" data-lang="python"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="ch">#!/usr/bin/env python3</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="nn">time</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="nn">os</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">while</span> <span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">:</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">time</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sleep</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">exist</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">popen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&#34;ps -ef | grep WeChat.exe&#34;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">e</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">exist</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">readlines</span><span class="p">()</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">e</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">:</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">e</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&#34;WeChat not started. Exit...&#34;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="n">exit</span><span class="p">()</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">output</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">popen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&#34;wmctrl -l -G -p -x&#34;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">s</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">output</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">readlines</span><span class="p">()</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">s</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="nb">id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">&#39;&#39;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">item</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">s</span><span class="p">:</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">find</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&#34;wechat.exe.Wine&#34;</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">            <span class="nb">id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">split</span><span class="p">()[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">            <span class="k">break</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="n">output</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">close</span><span class="p">()</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">id</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">id</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="s1">&#39;&#39;</span><span class="p">:</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="n">shadow</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">id</span><span class="p">[:</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="s2">&#34;0014&#34;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">shadow</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">system</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&#34;xdotool windowunmap &#34;</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">shadow</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&#34;WeChat not display yet.&#34;</span><span class="p">)</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>给这个脚本放在一个合适的位置, 加上权限后链接到<code>/bin/disable-wechat-shadow</code></p>
<p>然后编写启动脚本:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="cp">#!/bin/sh
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="cp"></span>env <span class="nv">WINEDEBUG</span><span class="o">=</span>-all /bin/wechat <span class="p">&amp;</span> /bin/disable-wechat-shadow</span></span></code></pre></div><p>然后把这个脚本加上执行权限, 链接到<code>/bin/wechat-start</code>.</p>
<p>修改开始菜单中wechat的启动命令.将其改为<code>/bin/wechat-start</code>.</p>
<p>然后再打开微信, 登录后的主窗口阴影过一小会儿就消失了.</p>
<h2 id="小问题" class="heading-element"><span>小问题</span>
  <a href="#%e5%b0%8f%e9%97%ae%e9%a2%98" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p>如果你把wechat给关闭了, 或者最小化了, 它每次恢复窗口的时候都会重新绘制阴影. 所以无奈之下只能在wechat运行期间让脚本定时检测了. 时间间隔不敢设置的太短, 导致总有一小段时间会显示阴影, 不过也就3~4秒, 不耽误使用.</p>
<h2 id="todo" class="heading-element"><span>ToDo</span>
  <a href="#todo" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><ul>
<li>
<p>在<a href="https://www.limstash.com/articles/201905/1391"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">Limstash的博客:通过 wine 完美运行最新版网易云音乐</a>这篇文章里作者用C++和X11的接口实现了一个简单的窗口劫持, 在启动网易云之后只需要运行一次即可关闭, 不需要一直挂着脚本. 我看到这篇博文之前也写过一个类似的程序, 效果还不如这位大佬的, 就不贴出来了. 在尝试把代码简单的修改来适应微信的阴影关闭时发现这两个程序有一些不一样的地方, 修改后的程序也没法正常运行, 遂作罢. 等再有时间了好好从头撸一个.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>wine的应用没法和KDE的媒体管理器进行集成, 也就影响到<code>KDE Connect</code>的效果, 在来电话时不能够自动暂停音乐的播放, 也不能通过远程媒体控制器来遥控电脑. 不过这个问题解决起来恐怕就要动大工程了.</p>
</li>
</ul><hr />

article.title: KDE上TIM无法打开文件所在位置的解决方案
article.content:
<h2 id="前言" class="heading-element"><span>前言</span>
  <a href="#%e5%89%8d%e8%a8%80" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p>自从上次用过<code>Arch Linux</code>滚挂之后, 辗转于<code>Manjaro</code>, <code>Deepin</code>, <code>Fedora</code>, 最后还是趁着没法出门, 在家里把<code>Arch Linux</code>又整上了. 但是安装好TIM之后还是老问题, KDE下面用TIM下载群文件之后没法点击打开文件夹来方便的定位文件.</p>
<p>正好闲着没事干, 就解决一下这个问题.</p>
<h2 id="过程" class="heading-element"><span>过程</span>
  <a href="#%e8%bf%87%e7%a8%8b" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><h3 id="查看出错" class="heading-element"><span>查看出错</span>
  <a href="#%e6%9f%a5%e7%9c%8b%e5%87%ba%e9%94%99" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p>右键应用程序启动器, 打开编辑应用程序, 找到TIM, 复制启动指令, 然后打开一个终端并粘贴指令, 执行. 这样就可以在打开TIM的时候查看详细的应用程序输出了. 果不其然, 在我下载完测试文件点击打开文件夹的时候提示找不到指令<code>dde-file-manager</code>.</p>
<h3 id="第一次解决" class="heading-element"><span>第一次解决</span>
  <a href="#%e7%ac%ac%e4%b8%80%e6%ac%a1%e8%a7%a3%e5%86%b3" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p><code>dde-file-manager</code>是Deepin操作系统的文件管理器, 而在KDE里面文件管理器是<code>dolphin</code>. 于是想办法:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo ln -s /bin/dolphin /bin/dde-file-manager</span></span></code></pre></div><p>试图通过给<code>dolphin</code>链接到<code>dde-file-manager</code>来伪造一个Deepin文件管理器, 将使用Deepin文件管理器打开的命令链接到<code>dolphin</code>上来解决. 但是点击链接依然打不开.</p>
<h3 id="再次查看出错" class="heading-element"><span>再次查看出错</span>
  <a href="#%e5%86%8d%e6%ac%a1%e6%9f%a5%e7%9c%8b%e5%87%ba%e9%94%99" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p>还是同样的方法, 发现在单击链接之后<code>dolphin</code>报错无效的选项<code>show-item</code>. Google之, 发现深度文件管理器可以通过<code>dde-file-manager --show-item $FilePath</code>的形式来打开路径并高亮选中文件.</p>
<h3 id="第二次解决" class="heading-element"><span>第二次解决</span>
  <a href="#%e7%ac%ac%e4%ba%8c%e6%ac%a1%e8%a7%a3%e5%86%b3" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p>运行<code>dolphin --help</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">$ dolphin --help
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">Usage: dolphin <span class="o">[</span>options<span class="o">]</span> +<span class="o">[</span>Url<span class="o">]</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">文件管理器
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">Options:
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  -h, --help           Displays <span class="nb">help</span> on commandline options.
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  --help-all           Displays <span class="nb">help</span> including Qt specific options.
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  -v, --version        Displays version information.
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  --author             显示作者信息.
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  --license            显示版权信息.
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  --desktopfile &lt;文件名&gt;  此应用程序的桌面条目的基础文件名
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  --select             参数中传递的文件和文件夹会被选中. 
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  --split              Dolphin 将以拆分视图启动. 
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  --new-window         Dolphin 将明确地在新窗口中打开. 
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  --daemon             启动 Dolphin 守护进程 <span class="o">(</span>只在使用 DBus 接口时需要<span class="o">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">Arguments:
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  +<span class="o">[</span>Url<span class="o">]</span>               要打开的文档</span></span></code></pre></div><p>从参数列表来看只需要把<code>--show-item</code>参数更换成<code>--select</code>参数就可以了. 我选择拿python简单的写几句来实现这个功能. 首先删掉原先的<code>dde-file-manager</code>链接: <code>sudo rm /bin/dde-file-manager</code></p>
<p>然后想办法让python接受两个参数, 并调换第一个参数.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-python" data-lang="python"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">##!/bin/python3</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">## -*- coding: UTF-8 -*-</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">## 文件名: dde-file-manager.py</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="nn">sys</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="nn">os</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">options</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">sys</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">argv</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">path</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">sys</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">argv</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">system</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&#34;dolphin --select &#34;</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="s1">&#39;&#34;&#39;</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="s1">&#39;&#34;&#39;</span><span class="p">)</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>简单的替换掉就可以了. 加上执行权限, 扔到<code>$HOME/.local/share</code>目录下面, 然后:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo ln <span class="nv">$HOME</span>/.local/share/dde-file-manager.py /bin/dde-file-manager</span></span></code></pre></div><p>再然后打开TIM, 接收文件, 点击打开所在文件夹, 就可以非常顺利的用<code>dolphin</code>打开文件夹了.</p>
<h2 id="结尾" class="heading-element"><span>结尾</span>
  <a href="#%e7%bb%93%e5%b0%be" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p>如果网上找不到现有的办法可以解决某些小bug, 就动手自己解决. 通常情况下这些问题并不复杂, 只是大部分人会永远把自己局限在一个新手的层面, 除了Google和百度就不肯自己动手发现问题了. 事实证明, 自己动手, 还是很明智的一个选择.</p><hr />

article.title: 如何在Linux上优雅地堕落-1
article.content:
<h2 id="前言" class="heading-element"><span>前言</span>
  <a href="#%e5%89%8d%e8%a8%80" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p>为什么折腾了这么久<code>Linux</code>, 才想起来整一个博文呢? emmmm因为老是崩盘嘛&hellip; 导致我每次重新配置环境都要想半天, 我之前那个软件是怎么装上的. 后来实在受不了, 索性抛弃了<code>Arch</code>转向了稍微友好一点的<code>Manjaro</code>. 于是我决定写一篇博文, 免得<code>Manjaro</code>哪天抽风了又要忙活好久. 不过还是得感叹一下<code>Manjaro</code>的稳定性.</p>
<p>小更新: 又换回<code>Arch Linux</code>了hhhh. <code>Manjaro</code>虽然好, 但是有些地方还是自己手动配置比较舒服.</p>
<h2 id="正文" class="heading-element"><span>正文</span>
  <a href="#%e6%ad%a3%e6%96%87" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><h3 id="安装" class="heading-element"><span>安装</span>
  <a href="#%e5%ae%89%e8%a3%85" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p>由于某些软件和游戏的原因, 暂时还是脱离不了<code>Windows</code>的怀抱. 虚拟机的体验太差了, 于是经过多方面考虑, 最终决定采用双系统的办法. 首先在<code>Windows</code>上用自带的磁盘管理或者其他的分区工具找好地方, 开辟一个<code>100GB</code>左右的空间出来, 然后从镜像站嫖来最新版的<code>Snapshot</code>镜像, 用<code>Ultra ISO</code>以<code>RAW</code>的格式写进一个空间足够大的U盘里, 开机从U盘启动, 安装过程一切顺利. <code>UEFI</code>的启动方式需要把硬盘上第一个<code>FAT32</code>分区挂载到<code>/boot/efi</code>上, 千万不要手抖选择格式化, 否则你就要失去亲爱的<code>Windows</code>了.</p>
<p>其他的设置无需多说了, Office套件我选择的是<code>Libre Office</code>, 毕竟从现在来说这个发行版是最稳定的, 没有其他一些奇奇怪怪的问题, 同时也比<code>Open Office</code>颜值高那么一点.</p>
<p>桌面环境当然首选<code>KDE</code>啊, 使用不习惯<code>Gnome</code>的操作逻辑. 并且既然是要配置一个自己舒服的桌面环境, 高度可配置的<code>KDE</code>当然是第一选择.</p>
<h3 id="基本配置" class="heading-element"><span>基本配置</span>
  <a href="#%e5%9f%ba%e6%9c%ac%e9%85%8d%e7%bd%ae" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><h4 id="软件源" class="heading-element"><span>软件源</span>
  <a href="#%e8%bd%af%e4%bb%b6%e6%ba%90" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h4><p>因为校内网有镜像站, 所以需要修改一下软件源, 这样就可以很方便的安装软件, 进行后面的配置.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo vi /etc/pacman.d/mirrorlist</span></span></code></pre></div><p>在最上面按照格式添加学校的镜像站, 然后打开<code>/etc/pacman.conf</code>添加<code>Archlinuxcn</code>源:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-json" data-lang="json"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">[</span><span class="err">archlinuxcn</span><span class="p">]</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="err">Server</span> <span class="err">=</span> <span class="err">https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/archlinuxcn/$arch</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>然后执行</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo pacman -Syy</span></span></code></pre></div><p>来刷新软件源缓存, 然后</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo pacman -Syu</span></span></code></pre></div><p>来将系统更新到最新的版本.</p>
<h4 id="网络加速" class="heading-element"><span>网络加速</span>
  <a href="#%e7%bd%91%e7%bb%9c%e5%8a%a0%e9%80%9f" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h4><p>因为配置过程中需要大量使用<code>GitHub</code>, 所以我们修改一下<code>/etc/hosts</code>文件, 以更快的从<code>GitHub</code>下载软件.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo nano /etc/hosts</span></span></code></pre></div><p>然后用<code>dig</code>或者<code>nslookup</code>指令找出<code>GitHub</code>相关域名的IP地址. 2019年11月3日可用的IP如下:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">## GitHub Start</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">192.30.253.112 github.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">192.30.253.119 gist.github.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">185.199.108.153 assets-cdn.github.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">151.101.128.133 raw.githubusercontent.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">151.101.128.133 gist.githubusercontent.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">151.101.128.133 cloud.githubusercontent.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">151.101.128.133 camo.githubusercontent.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">151.101.128.133 avatars0.githubusercontent.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">151.101.128.133 avatars1.githubusercontent.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">151.101.128.133 avatars2.githubusercontent.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">151.101.128.133 avatars3.githubusercontent.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">151.101.128.133 avatars4.githubusercontent.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">151.101.128.133 avatars5.githubusercontent.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">151.101.128.133 avatars6.githubusercontent.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">151.101.128.133 avatars7.githubusercontent.com
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">151.101.128.133 avatars8.githubusercontent.com

  </a>
</h5><p>这里的开发环境指的是各种语言的编译环境.</p>
<p>使用以下指令安装几个比较常见的编译工具:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo pacman -S gcc clang python python2</span></span></code></pre></div><p>java可以用</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">yay jdk</span></span></code></pre></div><p>来选择自己想用的版本. 博主用的是openjdk1.8.0, 因为Minecraft可以用这个版本跑起来 ( 手动狗头 )</p>
<h5 id="shell-fish" class="heading-element"><span>Shell: Fish</span>
  <a href="#shell-fish" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h5><p>对, 你没有看错, 这是一条鱼. 笔者的<code>Shell</code>使用本来受到<code>Arch Linux</code>的习惯影响, 是使用<code>zsh</code>作为自己的<code>Shell</code>的, 但是经过<code>Konge</code>学长的推荐, 尝试了这个号称宇宙第一<code>Shell</code>的<code>Fish</code>. 果不其然, 用户体验良好, 准备常驻了.</p>
<p>要安装<code>Fish</code>, 只需要:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo pacman -S fish</span></span></code></pre></div><p>然后在终端里输入<code>fish</code>就可以进入然后开启快乐旅程了.</p>
<p>我们把<code>fish</code>设为默认的<code>Shell</code>. 首先打开<code>Konsole</code>的配置方案管理, 编辑配置方案, 启动命令从<code>/bin/bash</code>换成<code>/bin/fish</code>. 接着重启<code>Konsole</code>. 然后把用户的默认<code>shell</code>也换成<code>fish</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo chsh -s /usr/bin/fish root
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo chsh -s /usr/bin/fish <span class="o">[</span>username<span class="o">]</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p><code>fish</code>每次启动时都会有打招呼内容, 我们用以下命令来自定义这句话:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="nb">set</span> fish_greeting <span class="s1">&#39;Your Greeting Words&#39;</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>对<code>fish</code>进行配置是十分人性化的, 只需要输入<code>fish_config</code>就可以了, 然后<code>fish</code>会打开本地的一个端口并启动浏览器, 以可视化的方式呈现出<code>fish</code>的各项配置. 功能设置十分的详细. 按照自己的喜好调整好就可了.</p>
<h5 id="包管理器-yay" class="heading-element"><span>包管理器: yay</span>
  <a href="#%e5%8c%85%e7%ae%a1%e7%90%86%e5%99%a8-yay" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h5><p>要充分发挥<code>Arch</code>系Linux的强大之处, 没有<code>AUR</code>怎么能行呢? 所以我们安装<code>yay</code>作为辅助<code>pacman</code>的包管理器.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo pacman -S yay</span></span></code></pre></div><p>今后安装软件如果不清楚名称, 就可以</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">yay <span class="o">[</span>Package Name<span class="o">]</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>来进行搜索, 然后很方便的安装了.</p>

<p>为了让<code>vim</code>更加的好用, 我们可以使用<a href="https://spacevim.org/cn/"target="_blank" rel="external nofollow noopener noreferrer">SpaceVim</a>来改善自己的用户体验. 如何安装请参照官网使用指南, 在此不再赘述.</p>

</h5><p>经过微软的开源和诸多开发者的贡献之后, Visual Studio Code现在已经无愧于最强代码编辑器的称号了. (当然, 博主并不是在这里引战, 如果你非要用Sublime或者Atom也莫得关系) ArchlinuxCN源中有vscode的二进制版.</p>

<p>我一般会对VSCode进行一点小配置, 然后装一些插件. 这里推荐使用Fira Code作为字体并开启字体连字, 某些符号看起来真的无比舒服.</p>

</h4><h5 id="下拉式终端-tilda" class="heading-element"><span>下拉式终端: Tilda</span>

  </a>
</h5><p>本来<code>Manjaro</code>是自带了一个<code>Yakuake</code>下拉式终端, 但是我实在是用不习惯, 并且它的显示有时候会出些问题. 因此我卸载了<code>Yakuake</code>装了<code>Tilda</code>. 打开设置, 在设置 &gt; 开机和关机 &gt; 自动启动里添加启动项, 并选择应用程序, 输入<code>Tilda</code>并开启.</p>
<p>在桌面上直接敲<code>Tilda</code>, 可以从KDE的快速启动器中启动<code>Tilda</code>. 启动后我们可以进行一些设置, 比如透明度, 颜色, 启动命令, 延迟, 自动隐藏规则等等.</p>
<h5 id="应用程序启动器-latte-dock" class="heading-element"><span>应用程序启动器: Latte-Dock</span>
  <a href="#%e5%ba%94%e7%94%a8%e7%a8%8b%e5%ba%8f%e5%90%af%e5%8a%a8%e5%99%a8-latte-dock" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h5><p>虽然我没有用过<code>Mac OS X</code>, 但是对其高效的桌面念念不忘. 同时我又想节省一下空间, <code>Windows</code>下面, 厚重的任务栏就占去了一部分屏幕, 标题栏又削一层, 菜单栏又削一层&hellip; 最后留给应用程序的显示空间就少了不必要的一部分. 于是我想找到一种办法, 把菜单, 标题, 状态栏集中在一个<code>bar</code>上面, 任务栏没办法, 要保证同时可用性, 就只能弄一个<code>dock</code>当任务栏, 在窗口活动时自动隐藏了. <code>Latte Dock</code>原生和KDE集成在一起, 通过它可以享受很棒的<code>dock</code>.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo pacman -S latte-dock</span></span></code></pre></div><p>按照和<code>tilda</code>同样的方法把<code>latte-dock</code>也设置为自动启动, 然后在快速启动器里面输入<code>latte</code>并回车, 就可以看见<code>dock</code>了. 然后把任务栏拖动到屏幕上方, 右键任务栏配置面板, 把开始菜单和任务管理器, 虚拟桌面都删掉, 留下显示桌面和状态栏即可. 然后在面板左侧添加空白. 然后添加控件, 选择全屏的应用程序启动面板, 并拖动到<code>Latte-Dock</code>的第一个位置. <code>Latte-Dock</code>的默认隐藏策略就很智能, 无需单独配置. 在添加控件的侧栏下方安装新控件, 搜索<code>Application Title</code>并安装, 然后配置任务栏那一行, 拖动全局菜单到最左侧, 旁边插入空白, 再插入<code>Application Title</code>, 再插入空白, 最后是状态栏等控件.</p>
<p>最后我们想办法, 把最大化窗口的标题栏去掉. 在<code>./.config/kwinrc</code>中找到<code>[Windows]</code>的选项, 然后按照以下方式配置:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-ini" data-lang="ini"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="k">[Windows]</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="na">BorderlessMaximizedWindows</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">true</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="na">ElectricBorderCooldown</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">350</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="na">ElectricBorderCornerRatio</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">0.25</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="na">ElectricBorderDelay</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">150</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="na">ElectricBorderMaximize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">true</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="na">ElectricBorderTiling</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">true</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="na">ElectricBorders</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">1</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="na">RollOverDesktops</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">true</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>配置完成后的效果大概如图所示.</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/39OkRIvcPWSyeHp.png" alt="blog2.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/39OkRIvcPWSyeHp.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/39OkRIvcPWSyeHp.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/39OkRIvcPWSyeHp.png?size=large 2x" data-title="blog2.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/hr6Ea92FSNxWKQ1.png" alt="blog3.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/hr6Ea92FSNxWKQ1.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/hr6Ea92FSNxWKQ1.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/hr6Ea92FSNxWKQ1.png?size=large 2x" data-title="blog3.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/1xjCIT9O7YlNewS.png" alt="blog1.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/1xjCIT9O7YlNewS.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/1xjCIT9O7YlNewS.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/1xjCIT9O7YlNewS.png?size=large 2x" data-title="blog1.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<p><img loading="lazy" src="https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/ja5GEbLqzo73yxn.png" alt="blog4.png" srcset="https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/ja5GEbLqzo73yxn.png?size=small, https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/ja5GEbLqzo73yxn.png?size=medium 1.5x, https://i.loli.net/2019/11/03/ja5GEbLqzo73yxn.png?size=large 2x" data-title="blog4.png" style="background: url(/images/loading.min.svg) no-repeat center;" onload="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}this.dataset.lazyloaded='';" onerror="this.title=this.dataset.title;for(const i of ['style', 'data-title','onerror','onload']){this.removeAttribute(i);}"/></p>
<h5 id="输入法-fcitx-pinyin" class="heading-element"><span>输入法: Fcitx-pinyin</span>
  <a href="#%e8%be%93%e5%85%a5%e6%b3%95-fcitx-pinyin" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h5><p>作为中国人, 配置了这么久才发现自己连中文输入都不能&hellip; 那怎么能行, 当然要装一下中文输入法了.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">sudo pacman -S fcitx-im fcitx-configtool</span></span></code></pre></div><p>这条指令会安装<code>fcitx</code>和<code>fcitx</code>的图形化管理界面. 但是安装好后依旧无法输入中文, 这个时候先把<code>fcitx</code>设为开机启动, 然后终端输入<code>fcitx-diagnose</code>运行诊断, 然后按照诊断来进行配置和修复. 一般情况下你只要配置一下<code>$HOME/.xprofile</code>这个文件就好了, 在下面添加如下内容 ( 如果没有这个文件就新建一个 ):</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-ini" data-lang="ini"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="na">export GTK_IM_MODULE</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">fcitx</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="na">export QT_IM_MODULE</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">fcitx</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="na">export XMODIFIERS</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&#34;@im=fcitx&#34;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="na">export SAL_USE_VCLPLUGIN</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">gtk</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="na">export LC_ALL</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&#34;zh_CN.UTF-8&#34;</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>注销后重新登录就可以使用了.</p>
<p>画个节点, 过两天继续更新.</p>

<h2 id="前言" class="heading-element"><span>前言</span>
  <a href="#%e5%89%8d%e8%a8%80" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><p>好了,本蒟蒻要开始写题解了…</p>
<p>比赛结束力!</p>
<h2 id="题解" class="heading-element"><span>题解</span>
  <a href="#%e9%a2%98%e8%a7%a3" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><h2 id="sign-in" class="heading-element"><span>Sign In</span>
  <a href="#sign-in" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><h3 id="你是西电新生吗" class="heading-element"><span>你是西电新生吗?</span>
  <a href="#%e4%bd%a0%e6%98%af%e8%a5%bf%e7%94%b5%e6%96%b0%e7%94%9f%e5%90%97" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p>签到题, 加入考试群, 在公告里面就可以发现<code>flag</code>, 复制, 提交, 一百分到手~</p>
<h2 id="reverse" class="heading-element"><span>Reverse</span>
  <a href="#reverse" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h2><h3 id="introducing-re" class="heading-element"><span>Introducing RE</span>
  <a href="#introducing-re" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p>这道题&hellip; 就是教你怎么用<code>IDA</code>的..</p>
<p>在网上找来的<code>IDA</code>资源, ,然后安装,打开,发现了这么几句:</p>
<pre tabindex="0"><code class="language-assembly" data-lang="assembly">mov     dword ptr [esp], offset aWelcomeToTheMo ; &#34;Welcome to the MoeCTF!&#34;
call    puts
mov     dword ptr [esp+17h], 63656F6Dh
mov     dword ptr [esp+1Bh], 447B6674h
mov     dword ptr [esp+1Fh], 6F595F30h
mov     dword ptr [esp+23h], 326B5F75h
mov     dword ptr [esp+27h], 495F776Fh
mov     dword ptr [esp+2Bh], 7D3F4144h
mov     byte ptr [esp+2Fh], 0
lea     eax, [esp+30h+var_19]
mov     [esp], eax      ; char *
call    sub_401500</code></pre><p>然后找了个16进制转ASCII的网站, 复制第三行的 <code>63 65 6F 6D</code> 进去, 发现解出来是 <code>ceom</code></p>
<p>啊嘞?反过来不就是 <code>moec</code> 么?</p>
<p>按照这个思路, 挨个复制然后反过来输出, 就把 <code>flag</code> 找到了.</p>
<h3 id="moe-re" class="heading-element"><span>Moe RE</span>
  <a href="#moe-re" class="heading-mark">
    <svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg>
  </a>
</h3><p>这道题我本来是第二题做的,, 后来发现竟然比我想象中的难&hellip;</p>
<p>下载了<code>re</code>, 发现打不开, 就扔进<code>Windows</code>的<code>Linux</code>子系统里, 发现依旧打不开, 啊嘞? 什么情况? 不行我重启到<code>Arch Linux</code>试试? 算了我懒得费那个神&hellip; 直接扔进IDA, 发现汇编读不懂, 就按了下F5, 得到了以下伪代码:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-c" data-lang="c"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kt">int</span> <span class="kr">__cdecl</span> <span class="nf">main</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">argc</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">const</span> <span class="kt">char</span> <span class="o">**</span><span class="n">argv</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">const</span> <span class="kt">char</span> <span class="o">**</span><span class="n">envp</span><span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">{</span>                   <span class="c1">// 注释是后来自己添加的
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">v3</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="c1">// eax
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="c1">// eax
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="c1">// [rsp+10h] [rbp-A0h]
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="c1">// [rsp+14h] [rbp-9Ch]
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">v7</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="c1">// [rsp+18h] [rbp-98h]
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="kr">__int64</span> <span class="n">v8</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="c1">// [rsp+20h] [rbp-90h]
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="kt">char</span> <span class="n">v9</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">104</span><span class="p">];</span> <span class="c1">// [rsp+40h] [rbp-70h]
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="kr">__int64</span> <span class="n">v10</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="c1">// [rsp+A8h] [rbp-8h]
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="nf">scanf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&#34;%s&#34;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">v9</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">envp</span><span class="p">);</span>   <span class="c1">// 获取输入 v9
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="n">v3</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nf">strlen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">v9</span><span class="p">);</span>         <span class="c1">// 获取输入长度
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="n">v7</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">v3</span><span class="p">;</span>                 <span class="c1">// 现在v3 == v7,都是长度
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="nf">strcpy</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="kt">char</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">v8</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">&#34;abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz&#34;</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="c1">// v8 好像是个 table
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>  <span class="k">for</span> <span class="p">(</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="n">v3</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="o">++</span><span class="n">i</span> <span class="p">)</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">      <span class="c1">//遍历输入, 然后把v9里每个字符和table的第i个字符进行异或运算...
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"></span>    <span class="n">v9</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">^=</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">_BYTE</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">v8</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">%</span> <span class="mi">26</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="c1">//*((_BYTE ... % 26)这句就相当于v8[i % 26]
